theme: A clear day; the kids and the Orlando weekend are the moving pieces.
greeting: A wide-open day, Dan — nothing on the calendar until tomorrow. The only real clock today is the kids at three and the drive over to Orlando.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open item
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando and Disney weekend is Saturday and Sunday, and tickets for all six of you are the only thing still unbooked. Check whether your ticket type needs park reservations before the choice of park narrows.

needsAttention.title: Claire's St Pete appointment
needsAttention.detail: Claire has a 10:20 AM appointment back in St Pete tomorrow while you're at the Orlando villa. That's an early start and a roughly two-hour drive worth planning around tonight.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The book-this-week refundable full-size SUV out of Portland is now about a week overdue. Holiday inventory at PWM sells out, so a refundable hold removes the whole risk at no cost.

flagged.title: LinkedIn messages waiting
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn digest flags two messages awaiting your reply — worth a glance for any networking follow-ups.

flagged.title: Venmo request from Joshua Weaver
flagged.detail: A $50 Venmo request for mowing (9/17) is sitting unpaid.

flagged.title: ICGN site needs a new login
flagged.detail: The new ICGN website is live and asks members to set up a fresh login for member-only content.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Delta, Bloomberg, Dwell, a local roundup, and a couple of retailers.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: Autumn is game and wild-mushroom season, and a slow braise suits the first cool evenings.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the morning is genuinely open.
Kids picked up at three, then the drive across to the Orlando villa.
Arrive at Royal Palms and get the six of you settled for the week.
